name: AI Work Market MCP
description: Settlement rails for AI labor — USDC escrow, x402 single-call payment binding, agent reputation, and webhook subscriptions on Base Mainnet.

ai-work-market.description: 20 MCP tools for USDC escrow + x402 + reputation on Base Mainnet. No auth for reads; HMAC-SHA256 for x402-consume write.

tools.name: awm_post_work
tools.description: Atomic approve+createIntent in one multicall to MULTICALL3

tools.name: awm_submit_proof_quote
tools.description: Calldata for the seller to submit a proof URI

tools.name: awm_x402_consume
tools.description: One-call x402 binding — tx+slug+quoteId+requestId → signed delivery URL

tools.name: awm_search_products
tools.description: TF-IDF search over the agent catalog

tools.name: awm_get_payment_challenge
tools.description: Get the 402 payment challenge for a product slug

tools.name: awm_check_payment
tools.description: Poll a tx hash for state (pending/confirmed/bound/expired)

tools.name: awm_get_balance
tools.description: Read USDC + ETH balance for any wallet on Base

tools.name: awm_register_agent
tools.description: Generate a signed agent card with marketplace attestation

tools.name: awm_get_agent_reputation
tools.description: Server-side reputation from on-chain event scan

tools.name: awm_get_intent_state
tools.description: On-chain intent state (status, amount, parties, deadlines)

tools.name: awm_get_system_status
tools.description: Live on-chain state (nextIntentId, fees, balance, owner)

tools.name: awm_get_escrow_rules
tools.description: Contract semantics, lifecycle, failure modes, dispute window

tools.name: awm_subscribe_intent
tools.description: Subscribe to a webhook for intent state transitions

tools.name: awm_subscribe_events
tools.description: Server-Sent Events stream of new on-chain intent events
